scope: Browser-local demo with fictional data; not a production accounting service

implemented.details: Derived from expenses, bills, invoices, payroll changes, documents, year end and expiring contracts; search and priority/type grouping
Dedicated transaction detail pages, bank summary cards, 20 new Swedish receipt examples, CSV import, receipt proposals, explicit matching, no double posting
Multiple originals stored in IndexedDB; receipt, supplier bill, self-bill and other classifications; duplicate hashes; retryable per-file errors
JPEG/PNG/WebP/BMP OCR, text PDF extraction, scanned PDF OCR, HEIC conversion; 10 MB/file, max 10 PDF pages; manual review; mixed VAT not supported
PDF/image intake to payable draft; supplier/invoice-number duplicate check, VAT separation, approval, simulated payment, original download
Customer records, quotes with multiple lines at one VAT rate, local acceptance, one-time conversion to invoice draft, printable HTML views, invoice issue/credit/recorded payment; no actual delivery
Monthly draft schedules, month-end anchoring, pause/resume, explicit generation and occurrence deduplication; no background scheduler
Prior-agreement confirmation, approval routine, seller-specific numbering, generated JSON; no dispatch or automatic legal validation
Project rates/budgets, billable/internal time, weekly totals, employee selection, week locking, time-to-invoice draft reservation; old time preserved
Employees, groups, absence types, compensation, extra gross/net/advance requests, benefits, local approval/rejection, manual payroll calculation, approved gross/benefit prefill, saved demo payslips
Dated scope/terms drafts, edits/version counter, text download and expiry tasks; no e-signing
Date/account filters, category costs, monthly sales, period/cumulative result, profit/loss, balance sheet, trial balance and CSV export from the local ledger
Typed non-payroll entity search, contextual FAQ, local advice drafts; no staffed support
SIE 1–4 preview/original preservation; limited SIE 4 transaction import and 4I export; PC8, mapping, duplicate/lock checks
Checklist and journal/trial balance/JSON handover; no statutory accounts or filing

production_gaps: Secure multi-tenant backend, authentication and permissions
design_handoff: Finis — modern visual identity: SUITE-HANDOFF.txt and 17-screen independent design prototype

browser_verified: Quote creation, acceptance and invoice conversion
Employee creation and approved bonus to payroll prefill
390px mobile dashboard and time view without document overflow

design_alignment: Spanish demo visual reference applied to Swedish workspace; Swedish ledger preserved. Full functional parity and Swedish English toggle are unfinished. See downloads/demo-audit.txt.
